applicability: prospective_billing contracts; forward plan elections, shared group qualification and partner vouchers.
content:
# Consolidated subscription billing and partner credits

Scope: `prospective_billing` contracts. Amounts are USD minor units.

## Monthly charges

Each billing period has its own plan election. The fixed subscription fee is charged once for the billing group. Variable fees sum the group's actual transaction counts at the rates of that period's plan. Domestic payments, overseas payments and currency conversions are separate billable categories; a conversion is not another overseas payment. Usage is aggregated over the operating accounts listed in the billing arrangement, not every account in the database. Settled historical statements are final; their paid fees and old usage do not affect upcoming charges.

The plan's variable-fee credit applies once for the group when its combined transaction count meets the listed threshold and at least one active account in the same group has the required partner tenure at the billing event. Tenure is the recorded business-day age; service minutes are processing steps and do not add business days. The credit reduces variable fees to a minimum of zero, without offsetting the fixed fee. It is not cash and unused credit does not carry forward. A plan remains available when the group fails its credit qualification, but the undiscounted variable charge applies.

Metered usage is posted at each billing event. Before then it has no final bank value. Customers may know their own future business volumes; the bank's historical statement cannot certify a new commercial forecast.

## Partner subscription vouchers

An owned customer-facing campaign code may reserve a credit for one open period. A valid reservation can be moved to another open period before consumption. At the selected period's billing event, the credit deducts the smaller of the campaign cap and that plan's fixed fee. It cannot offset variable fees, combine with a second redemption, or carry a remainder to another period. A redeemed voucher is consumed even when the eligible fixed fee is below its cap. The variable-fee credit and voucher can both apply because they cover different components.

The voucher requires an active same-group account with the stated partner tenure at redemption. Closure of the last qualifying account voids an unused campaign entitlement, including a reservation already entered. A consumed credit is not clawed back after subsequent account closure. The service supports one campaign voucher per group; it does not automatically apply offers from a customer's private partner correspondence.

## Election and closure

A plan may be selected or changed for either open period before that period's billing event. Requests and portal approvals alone do not change the election: the approved instruction must be executed. At the event, the final election and then-current eligibility determine the actual fee. Charges are final and cannot be refunded by changing a later plan. Payment failure leaves the bill unpaid. No plan change, account closure or voucher reservation transfers business transactions between accounts.

An active account can be closed. Closure is irreversible within this service, has no extra fee, and removes its eligibility contributions. The two operating accounts retain the customer's ongoing payment service. The billing arrangement identifies any former account to retire and its closure deadline. The minimum-cost service instruction compares the total of both upcoming periods, including fixed charges, variable fees and valid discounts; already paid historical fees are excluded.

## Operations

Unlock `propose_subscription_election`. Supply `case_id`, `action`, and `data`:

| Action | Fields | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `select_plan` | `record_id`, `plan_id` | Set or replace the election for an open billing-period record |
| `reserve_voucher` | `record_id`, `code` | Reserve the privately owned campaign code for an open billing-period record |
| `close_account` | `record_id` | Close the selected active account and update unused offer eligibility |

All instructions need a matching portal approval. The billing event records actual usage, each fee component, applied discounts and payment status. Read the actual records after processing. Failed instructions and read-only inquiries do not advance the billing clock.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_subscription_election`

Prepare a future subscription election, partner-voucher reservation or account closure under the consolidated billing contract.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
